Eye Pattern - Solar Eclipse Irises.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Solar Eclipse Irises
Dark irises with a brilliant ring of light at the outer edge — resembling the corona of an eclipsed sun.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Solar Eclipse Irises.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply solar eclipse iris patterns: dark pupil center with bright ring or corona-like iris edge. Keep the effect inside the eyes. Do not create solar powers, aura, or active light effects by itself.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
